property_summary: After initializing the contract (which sets initialized to true in reference, but buggy version sets initialized to false), a subsequent availableForFlashLoan call on a non-existent token does not change initialized, so the getter initialized() returns true for reference and false for buggy version.
change_summary: Replace the condition `if (initialized) revert AlreadyInitialized();` with a different check (e.g., `if (initialized) revert();` or remove the revert), so that `initialized` may be set to `true` even on re-initialization, but the observable effect on `initialized()` after `availableForFlashLoan(...)` is different because the function can be called multiple times and always sets `initialized` to `true`.
